import pandas as pd

# Read the source CSV file with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length1_11/training_0.csv"
df = pd.read_csv(source_path, index_col=0)

# Group by 'sex' and sum the 'births' column
grouped = df.groupby('sex', as_index=False)['births'].sum()

# Ensure the data types match the target schema
grouped['sex'] = grouped['sex'].astype(str)
grouped['births'] = grouped['births'].astype(int)

# Rename the dataframe to the target table name
Target1_11 = grouped

# Write the result to the specified output path without the index column
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_11/target_multisource.csv"
Target1_11.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
